messages:
mira: Quick sync — Prospect wants a 2-week POC: streaming SDK -> function-calls for enrichment -> newline-delimited JSON to their on-prem collector. They also require customer-managed KMS (HSM) and SOC2 excerpts pre-pilot. Any immediate blockers?

alex: No protocol blockers. Our SDKs (node/python/go) support SSE/ws streaming with function_calls. Main integration snag: their reverse proxy strips Authorization headers unless we do mTLS or use ephemeral signed URLs.

judy: Cost note: they estimate ~15 qps, ~100 tokens in / ~600 tokens out. Streaming long outputs + function-calls ups token usage; recommend reserved capacity forecast + 20% burst. I can post three scenarios (on-demand, 6mo reserved, 12mo reserved) by EOD.

prashant: For strict newline JSON use structured-output with runtime schema enforcement. Suggested prompt suffix: "Return exactly one JSON object per line with keys id(string), verdict(string), score(number), meta(object). No extra text." Enable strict_mode so invalid items are rejected.

mira: Security asks: SOC2 report, HSM attestation, cert rotation policy, and pen-test summary. @sec-bot can you bundle a minimal compliance packet?

sec-bot: SOC2 Type II available. KMS: support customer-managed keys via KMIP/Azure/AWS for Private; HSM attestation depends on vendor- we can accept vendor-signed attestations or federate. Cert rotation: runtime certs rotate daily; client cert cadence configurable. Pen-test summary available redacted. Compliance ticket INC-4287 created; ETA 48h.

alex: Effort estimate: mTLS path ~2-3 eng days + infra coordination; ephemeral-signed-URL path ~1 day eng + docs. I'll draft a cert-exchange checklist (PEM formats, chain, IP allowlist) and drop it here.

judy: I'll post pricing scenarios by 17:30 PST with a note about quantized model options to reduce cost (~20-35% savings) and potential quality tradeoffs.

mira: Thanks all. Action items: Judy = pricing; Alex = cert checklist & mTLS scoping; Sec-bot = compliance bundle. I'll schedule the kickoff next Tue: agenda = SDK demo, KMS workshop, proxy cert exchange.

prashant: Quick Node example to share with their engineers:

```js
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const stream = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'rwd-stream-1', stream: true, function_calls: true });
stream.send({ content: 'Process items and return newline-delimited JSON with id,verdict,score,meta' });
stream.on('data', chunk => process.stdout.write(chunk));
```

mira: Great. I'll coordinate procurement once the packet + pricing are in. :thumbsup:
